title: CFX workflows and connector status
description: Explore CFX workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

Ansys (Synopsys)

CFX

Ansys CFX supports CFD workflows for turbomachinery and general fluid-flow analysis.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Prepare rotating domains

Use the fluid domain, geometry cleanup and meshing intent. In the intended CFX preview, prepare rotating domains; the visible result is a domain view with regions, interfaces and mesh controls exposed. Review watertightness, scale, near-wall treatment and cell quality before accepting or exporting it.

Configure flow interfaces

Start from the selected fluids, boundaries and physics models. In the intended CFX preview, configure flow interfaces; the visible result is a configured case with inlet, outlet, wall and solver settings visible. Review physical assumptions, reference values and convergence monitors before accepting or exporting it.

Review performance and convergence

Begin with the result fields, monitor history and balance reports. In the intended CFX preview, review performance and convergence; the visible result is contours and performance quantities tied to the solved domain. Review residuals, conservation, mesh sensitivity and expected flow behaviour before accepting or exporting it.
